ABOUT

· ABOUT FUNNGRO ·

Built so young Indians can earn for real.

Funngro started in 2022 to give young Indians a real way to turn their time online into income. Four years on, seventy lakh young Indians have made this their first earning platform.

· FOUNDED BY ·

Two operators. Two decades each.

FOUNDER · CEO

Payal Jain

IIM Calcutta alumna with two decades across Worldline, Syntel and Capgemini before starting Funngro. Pitched on Shark Tank India Season 2 and closed an investment from Amit Jain and Namita Thapar. Leads vision, product and the Teenlancer engine that now runs most of the company.

LINKEDIN ▸

CO-FOUNDER · CFO

Anik Jain

IIM Calcutta PGDCM. Two decades in BFSI and insurtech across ICICI Lombard, Reliance Life, Marsh, Mahindra and most recently CEO of Symbo. Owns finance, partnerships and the unit economics that took Funngro to its first profitable quarter.

LINKEDIN ▸

· THE JOURNEY ·

Four years. Five inflection points.

FY22

Founded.

Two founders. An MVP. Users doubled in the first 30 days. Zero paid marketing.

DEC 2022

Shark Tank India · Season 2.

National broadcast. Received an investment offer from the Sharks. Users doubled again in 30 days.

2023

One million users. Zero ad spend.

Pure referral growth. India's youth found us because the payouts were real.

Q4 FY25

First profitable quarter.

3M users. Ranked #9 education app in India on Google Play. Turned the corner on unit economics.

FY26

Scale + profit.

70 Lakh+ young Indians earning. 5,000+ brands working with our users. 1,000+ live projects. 10 of 12 months profitable.

· THE TEENLANCER ENGINE ·

One hundred young Indians run the company.

The Funngro operations moat nobody else in Indian ad-tech has built. Our support, QA, content, community and product research are all staffed by young Indians who started as users.

01
Support & Onboarding

User queries, first response, resolution. Brand onboarding, campaign setup.

02
Quality Assurance

Community-powered QA. Bug bashes. Every release tested by the people using it.

03
Content & Design

Social, in-app, and marketing creatives. Built by the audience itself.

04
Community · Clans

One hundred clan leaders managing tens of thousands of earners across India.

· BACKED BY ·

The investor and the moment.

🦈 AS SEEN ON

Shark Tank India · Season 2

December 2022. We pitched on national television. The episode led to an investment from Amit Jain via SucSEED Indovation. Our user base doubled in the 30 days that followed.

READ THE INSIDE STORY ▸

LEAD INVESTOR

Amit Jain · SucSEED Indovation

The investor who said yes when the category was unproven. Has stayed engaged through every fundraise, every regulatory question, and every hard quarter. Funngro is what it is partly because of his patience.

· WANT TO WORK HERE? ·

The team grows from Teenlancers. Very openly.

Most of the team started as users. You can too.
